duration.text: The Imageology and Nuclear Medicine at Nanjing Medical University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of undergraduate school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) 6.Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1 Aged under 40 2.Be in good health condition 3.Applicant should hold Bachelor's degree Admission comes after examination of those files by tutors and SIE and university. An examination follows after one year study in degree program. Failure in this examination will rob the candidates of their chance to do graduation papers and render them into trainees, who are allowed to continue their study, or render them a completion of schooling.
